item.title: Pakistan to review T20 World Cup 2026 participation if Bangladesh’s issue remains unresolved: Report
item.description: With nearly three weeks remaining for the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026, Bangladesh’s participation in the global showpiece continues to remain uncertain. The Bangla Tigers are scheduled to play their T20 World Cup group-stage fixtures in Kolkata and Mumbai. However, the BCB has refused to travel to India, citing securing concerns. item.description: Veteran opener Rohit Sharma, who remains active only in the ODI format for India, had returned to international cricket with a bang on the tour of Australia last October, earning the Player-of-the-Series award. item.title: WATCH- ‘Ma’am kyu bola raha hai?’- Harshit Rana reveals Virat Kohli's words to him on meeting Anushka Sharma for the first time
item.description: Harshit Rana has been a valuable asset to the Indian team, particularly in the white-ball format. Constantly backed by Indian head coach Gautam Gambhir, Harshit Rana made his India debut in 2024 in Tests and last year in white-ball cricket. He has provided India with the ability of someone who bowls at 140kph and can tonk a few balls at no.8 in the batting order. item.title: Pat Cummins to miss at least two T20 World Cup 2026 games, confirms Australia chief selector George Bailey
item.description: Australia’s men’s chief selector George Bailey on Monday (January 19) confirmed that Pat Cummins won’t be able to participate in at least the first couple of T20 World Cup 2026 games. Cummins is yet to recover from his lumbar bone stress injury sustained before the 2025-26 Ashes series, which kept him sidelined from four out of five Tests. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: “We didn’t bat well, long enough”- India captain Shubman Gill on historic ODI series defeat to New Zealand
item.description: India captain Shubman Gill blamed the failure of batters as the Men in Blue lost the third ODI to New Zealand by 41 runs in Indore. As a result, India also suffered a historic, first-ever ODI series loss at home to New Zealand. Daryl Mitchell’s 137 and Glenn Phillips’s 106 led New Zealand to 337/8 in 50 overs. item.description: Former BCCI chief selector Kris Srikkanth showered rich praise on Harshit Rana, acknowledging his all-round improvement in international cricket. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: "More than Kuldeep, it is Ravindra Jadeja..”- Zaheer, Rahane point out flaw in Shubman Gill’s captaincy, highlight misuse of spinners
item.description: India veterans Ajinkya Rahane and Zaheer Khan have pointed out how Shubman Gill’s captaincy possibly cost India the third ODI against New Zealand, which was played in Indore on Sunday, January 18. Rahane pointed out how Gill misused his two spinners, Kuldeep Yadav and Ravindra Jadeja, allowing Kiwi batters to dominate.
